pages.text: [#](53341a)The world you walk in is not the only world that exists. The Spirit World lies beside it, separated by a boundary that thins around places of power and at the edges of sleep.[#]()
pages.title: The Spirit World

pages.text: [#](53341a)To enter, drink a Brew of Sleeping near an altar, or eat an Apple of Sleeping. Your prone Body remains at the centre of the entry block with your name, skin, and entry health. It cannot be pushed and persists until you return.[#]()
[#](53341a)If another player destroys it, you are torn awake immediately.[#]()

[#](53341a)Carries you across, leaving your inventory behind. Only a few things cross with you — your Icy Needles, your Mutandis, and this very Primer — and a little of what you gather there, the cotton and the spirits, will follow you home.[#]()
pages.title: Brew of Sleeping

pages.text: [#](53341a)Brings you back at once, used up. Dying also returns you, less comfortably. In emergencies: **/witchery exit**.[#]()
pages.title: Icy Needle

pages.text: [#](53341a)Brew it from **Purified Milk**, a **Cookie**, **Brew of Love**, **Whiff of Magic**, an **Icy Needle**, and an **Artichoke** — three bottles per working.[#]()
pages.title: Kettle: Brew of Sleeping
